name: Title
description: A title line with an optional small spaced-out label over it, in the centre, bottom centre or a corner; fades and rises in.

controls.name: Label
controls.description: Small line over the title, in spaced-out capitals; leave empty for none.

controls.name: Margin
controls.description: Distance from the frame's edges for every Place but Centre, in pixels (9x16: 80).

controls.name: Max Width
controls.description: Widest either line may be, in % of the frame width; a wider line shrinks to fit.

controls.name: Shadow
controls.description: Strength of the soft shadow under the text, 0 to 100.

controls.name: Fade
controls.description: Fade In (then full to the end), Steady (full throughout) or Fade Out (full from the first frame), to hold a title across several clips.

controls.name: Start
controls.description: When it starts to fade and rise in, in seconds (0.6 s in); not used by Steady and Fade Out.

controls.name: Duration
controls.description: Length of the rendered clip in seconds; with Fade In and Out or Fade Out it fades out over its last 0.5 s.
